title: Infinity Yoneda evaluation for arbitrary space-valued presheaves
statement:
Use the infinity categories and nested universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U\prime$ of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], and the coherent functor and mapping-space conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Small means $\mathcal U$-small, and $\mathcal S$ denotes the infinity category of small spaces. Let $D$ be a small infinity category, let $\mathcal P(D)=\operatorname{Fun}(D^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$, and let $j:D\to\mathcal P(D)$ send $d$ to $\operatorname{Map}_D(-,d)$. For every $F\in\mathcal P(D)$ and $d\in D$, evaluation of a coherent transformation at $\operatorname{id}_d$ induces an equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P(D)}(j(d),F)\simeq F(d).$$
These equivalences assemble into a natural equivalence of functors on $D^{\mathrm{op}}\times\mathcal P(D)$, with all higher homotopies retained.
